# get: the first path that holds a value
get-first .name .suite.runner
get-first .missing .suite.runner
get-first .nothing .missing .tests
get-first .nothing .count
get-first .missing .nothing
get-first .nothing .missing
get-first .missing .nothing --default 0.:list
get-first --default 0.:str="d" .missing
get-first .name --default 0.:str="d"
get-first --default 0.:str="d"
get-first
get-first .missing --default

# string: the same, as text
string-first .missing .suite.runner
string-first .nothing .missing --default none
string-first .missing .tests --default none
string-first .missing .tests
string-first .nothing
string-first .nothing .missing
string-first .count .name
string-or none .missing

# set: several pairs
as two set .name 0.:str="all" .fresh 0.:int=1
to_json @two
as chained set .fresh 0.:map .fresh.inside 0.:bool=true
to_json @chained
set .name
set .name 0.:int=1 .fresh
set .name.deeper 0.:int=1 .fresh 0.:int=2
as same set
to_json @same

# patch: a value that is empty is left out
as missing get .missing
as patched patch .name $missing .count 0.:int=3 .fresh $missing
to_json @patched
as untouched patch .name $missing
to_json @untouched
patch .name
as none patch
to_json @none

# push: at a path
as pushed push --at .tests 0.:str="b.bats" 0.:int=2
to_json @pushed
as deep push --at .suite.files 0.:null
to_json @deep
as unchanged push --at .tests
to_json @unchanged
push --at .name 0.:int=1
push --at .missing 0.:int=1
push --at
